mission.title: argo: Application/ApplicationSet: add support for templated helm value files
mission.description: Application/ApplicationSet: add support for templated helm value files. Requested by 66+ users.

steps.title: Check current argo deployment
steps.description:
Verify your argo version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
helm list -n argo 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working argo installation.

steps.title: Review argo configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant argo configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
kubectl get configmap -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argo
```
# Summary / Motivation

One annoying thing with helm values in values files is that they can't refer to other helm values.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Application/ApplicationSet: add support for templated helm…
steps.description:
This PR introduces a [helm-like tpl](https://helm.sh/docs/howto/charts_tips_and_tricks/#using-the-tpl-function) function to the ApplicationSets go-templating that allows users to make use of ad-hoc templates.
An example of how this function could be used and why it is useful can be found here:
```yaml
kind: ApplicationSet
spec:
  generators:
  - matrix:
      generators:
      - git:
          repoURL: https://example.com
          files:
            - path: "apps/*.yaml"
      - list:
          elements:
            - domainname: example1.com
            - domainname: example2.com

  goTemplate: true
  template:
    metadata:
      name: {{ .appname }}
    spec:
      project: myproject
      sources:
        - repoURL: https://example.com
          path: app/{{ .appname }}
          helm:
            valueFilesTemplates:
              - app/{{ .appname }}/values.yaml.gotmpl
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
kubectl get events -n argo --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Application/ApplicationSet: add support for templated helm…" is functioning correctly.
